parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description: The accelerated domain name. You can specify multiple domain names. Separate them with commas (,).

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description:
The end of the time range to query.

The date is in the ISO 8601 standard. Use UTC in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format.

> The end time must be later than the start time.

parameters.name: Interval
parameters.description:
The time granularity of the data to query. Unit: seconds.

The value of this parameter varies based on the time range specified by the StartTime and EndTime parameters. Valid values: 300 (5 minutes), 3600 (1 hour), and 86400 (1 day). For more information, see the table in the **Limits** section.

parameters.name: IspNameEn
parameters.description:
The English name of the carrier.

You can call the [DescribeDcdnRegionAndIsp](~~207199~~) operation to query the English name. If you do not set this parameter, data for all carriers is queried.

parameters.name: LocationNameEn
parameters.description:
The English name of the region.

You can call the [DescribeDcdnRegionAndIsp](~~207199~~) operation to query the English name. If you do not set this parameter, data for all regions is queried.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description:
The beginning of the time range to query.

The date is in the ISO 8601 standard. Use Coordinated Universal Time (UTC) in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format.
